negative_findings.description: Udruženje banaka Crne Gore (Association of Banks of Montenegro) — no official website URL was surfaced by search. Only third-party references were found: an NGO registry entry (nvoinfo.me) and media mentions of its officers (Mladen Rabrenović as president, Bratislav Pejaković as secretary general) and of a 'traditional banking conference'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Association is confirmed to exist and to co-organise the CBCG FinTech Hackathon, but its own conference agenda/sponsor pages could not be located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is the most likely publisher of ME-specific banking conference agendas and sponsor lists — the core artefact of this cell. Missing it leaves a hole in domestic event coverage.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated public careers/vacancy pages were surfaced for NLB Banka Podgorica, Hipotekarna banka, Erste Bank Montenegro or Lovćen banka. Searches returned Wikipedia entries, bank-profile aggregators and (for Hipotekarna) only a LinkedIn company page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Career-page coverage of ME banks is currently confirmed only for CKB and Prva banka.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Hiring signals from the second- and third-largest banks are missing, and LinkedIn — the apparent fallback channel — is ToS-restricted for automated collection.

negative_findings.description: No Montenegro-specific 'best digital bank' award programme was found. All award signals located are international programmes (Global Finance, Euromoney, The Banker) with a Montenegro country category, reported through ME media.
negative_findings.result_summary: Domestic digital-banking award ecosystem appears absent or not web-visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Means award-based weak signals must be sourced from international award bodies plus local press, not from a national awards body.

negative_findings.description: CBCG FinTech Hackathon editions confirmed for 2021 and 2022 only; no evidence surfaced of editions after 2022 in this pass. A UDG announcement page carries an odd '2028' slug that was not verified.
negative_findings.result_summary: The hackathon may be dormant; treat the channel as possibly historical until a recent edition is confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Affects whether this is a live monitoring feed or an archival source.

negative_findings.description: LinkedIn (company pages, job posts, INFINTECH showcase) is the richest single weak-signal channel for this cell but is partially login-walled and its terms of service prohibit automated scraping.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collectable only via analyst review or a licensed data arrangement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any pipeline design that assumes scraped LinkedIn hiring data is legally and operationally unsound.

negative_findings.description: Search snapshots of ZZZCG indicated zero currently listed vacancies, and ZZZCG has published notices about changes to how vacancies are advertised.
negative_findings.result_summary: The public vacancy feed may be thin, paginated behind a form, or partly migrated; volume must be validated before relying on it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Could produce false 'no hiring activity' conclusions if the feed is simply not fully exposed.

coverage_gaps.description: Career/vacancy channels are unmapped for NLB Banka Podgorica, Hipotekarna banka, Erste Bank Montenegro, Lovćen banka, Universal Capital Bank, Adriatic Bank, Ziraat Bank Montenegro and the Central Bank's own recruitment page.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the CBCG list of licensed banks (https://www.cbcg.me/me/javnost-rada/informacije/korisni-linkovi/banke-u-crnoj-gori) and, for each, probe /karijera, /kariera, /posao, /o-nama/karijera and /en/careers paths directly rather than via search engines.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payment actors are entirely unmapped in this cell: licensed payment institutions and e-money issuers, card processors, ATM/POS acquirers/deployers and PSPs operating in ME. Their hiring and conference presence is arguably a sharper signal than bank hiring.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the CBCG register of payment institutions and e-money institutions, then run the same job-posting/conference/award sweep against each registered entity name in sr and en.

coverage_gaps.description: Conference sponsor and exhibitor rosters were identified at the site level but no individual sponsor list was actually retrieved for any ME event (INFINTECH sponsor page, IT SPOT sponsor tiers, MFM partners). Only Technobank's general sponsor (Payten) was observed via media coverage.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Direct-fetch the sponsor/partner/exhibitor subpages per edition and archive them; use web.archive.org for prior editions to build a multi-year vendor-presence series.

coverage_gaps.description: Wider-Balkans events beyond Technobank and Balkan Payment Forum were not swept — e.g. Serbian, Croatian, Bosnian, Albanian and North Macedonian banking-technology conferences and national digital-banking awards where ME banks or their group parents (OTP, NLB, Erste) appear.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a per-country pass in each local language (bs/hr/mk/sq/sl) for 'konferencija bankarske tehnologije', 'sponzori', 'izlagači', 'nagrada digitalna banka'.

coverage_gaps.description: No compliant substitute for LinkedIn hiring data has been identified (e.g. licensed job-posting datasets, Google Jobs structured data, or bank ATS endpoints exposing JSON).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe each ME bank for a hosted ATS (TalentLyft, SmartRecruiters, Workday, Teamtailor) whose public board offers a structured feed; that is the legal, machine-readable path to the same signal.

coverage_gaps.description: The local-language glossary for this cell is built but untested against boolean job-board search: terms used include oglas za posao, slobodna radna mjesta, karijera, otvorene pozicije, platni promet, kartično poslovanje, digitalno bankarstvo, hakaton, takmičenje, nagrada, priznanje, sponzori, izlagači, konferencija, klaster. Not yet exercised: 'sistem osnovnog bankarstva'/'core banking' English-in-local usage, 'instant plaćanja', 'mobilno bankarstvo', 'PSD2 usklađenost', 'procesiranje kartica', 'bankomat/POS terminali'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run job-board and conference queries with the untested terms, including Latin/Cyrillic variants and the common English-in-Serbian job titles ('core banking developer', 'payments engineer').

brief: Montenegro's indirect weak-signal layer is small but unusually legible: hiring signals concentrate in three tiers — the state bureau ZZZCG, the banking trade portal Bankar.me which republishes bank vacancy notices verbatim, and a handful of bank-owned career pages (CKB, including its TalentLyft ATS board, and Prva banka), with commercial boards (Zaposli.ME, posao.crna.gora.me, Prekoveze, Careerjet) as a corroboration net. Event and sponsorship signals cluster around INFINTECH at Porto Montenegro, MFM Conference in Podgorica and IT SPOT, with the regional Technobank exhibition in Belgrade and the Balkan Payment Forum showing which vendors (notably Payten/Asseco SEE) are courting Western Balkan banks. Recognition and innovation signals come from international award programmes reported through ME media (Global Finance, Euromoney, The Banker) and from the CBCG FinTech Hub hackathon, co-organised with ICT Cortex and the Association of Banks — the latter being the clearest map of the domestic vendor bench (Logate and peers) that ME banks actually buy from. The main structural weaknesses are that LinkedIn, the single richest channel, is ToS-restricted for automated collection; that most ME banks beyond CKB have no discoverable career page; and that non-bank payment institutions are entirely unmapped in this pass.
